name: Scenario Planning
description: Develops three named scenarios (optimistic, base, pessimistic) for a decision or situation. Each scenario includes driving assumptions, key events, outcome description, and preparation actions. Produces a complete scenario set, not a description of scenario methodology. Use when the user asks about planning for different outcomes, thinking through best-case and worst-case scenarios, preparing for uncertainty, or building contingency plans. Do NOT use for business strategic scenario planning (use business strategy skills), risk registers for projects (use risk-assessment), or simple pros and cons comparisons (use pro-con-analysis).
